info.title: Ledgerly API
info.description: REST API for Ledgerly. All money values are integers in minor units (cents). Errors use RFC 9457 Problem Details (`application/problem+json`).

session.name: ledgerly_session
session.description: HttpOnly session cookie set by POST /v1/auth/login. In these docs, sign in first (demo: demo@ledgerly.app / correct-horse-ledger) and the browser sends it automatically.

type.description: A URI identifying the problem type

currency.description: Defaults to the household's base currency, and must match it: totals add amounts across accounts.

timeZone.description: Used by background jobs to know the household's 'today'

code.description: 6-digit authenticator code, or a recovery code like ABCD-EFGH-JKMN

current.description: True for the session making this request

otpauthUri.description: Render as a QR code for authenticator apps

recoveryCodes.description: Shown ONCE. Each code works one time if the authenticator is lost.

code.description: 6-digit authenticator code, or a recovery code like ABCD-EFGH-JKMN

amountMinor.description: The amount set for this month

rolloverMinor.description: Carried in from earlier months; negative = paying back an overspend

unbudgetedSpendingMinor.description: Spending this month in categories without a budget

startMonth.description: First month the budget applies to

monthlyPaceMinor.description: Average monthly change of the account over the last 6 months

ruleId.description: The rule automating this series, if any

duplicateCount.description: Rows skipped because they were imported before

broughtForwardMinor.description: Net worth at the end of last month (before this month's first day)

receivedMinor.description: Income so far this month, to today

spentMinor.description: Spending so far this month, to today

id.description: Optional client-generated UUID (v7 recommended). Lets a UI show the new row instantly (optimistic update) with its final id, and makes retries detectable.

nextCursor.description: Pass as ?cursor= to get the next page. null = no more pages.

affected.description: Rows changed (a deleted transfer counts both halves)

skipped.description: Ids ignored: not found, or transfers when categorising
